manifest.scope: sourceHash identifies measured working tree; baseCommit is its parent, not a claim of an unmodified checkout

method: First three owner decisions per category in dev-strength; frozen before examining eight-second outcomes. A later dev-strength diagnostic explicitly adds the first credible/no-shot-candidate category after observing its existence in the development ledger. Same full state/RNG; prescribed selected/best generated progressive/best generated shot then ordinary autonomous play. Presence is not a new zone entry. Dependent exploratory counterfactuals, no global policy change.
